sections.title: Entertainment Rights and IP Monitoring Agents
sections.description: For Universal Pictures, Warner Bros., Disney, and the entertainment IP management community.

blocks.heading: Content rights monitoring agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents monitoring digital platforms, social media, and streaming services for unauthorized use of studio-owned content — identifying copyright violations, unauthorized clips, and unapproved derivative works across the internet at a scale that human monitoring teams cannot achieve.

blocks.heading: Licensing and royalty tracking agents
paragraphs: Agents monitoring music licensing usage, book option renewals, and talent agreement payment milestones — ensuring that studios and production companies receive all contractual payments and that option windows don't expire unintentionally.

blocks.heading: Development slate monitoring agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents tracking competitive intelligence on studios' development slates — monitoring trade publications, public filings, and talent announcements for signals about upcoming competing projects.
Self-hosted deployment standard — entertainment IP monitoring data stays on studio infrastructure.

sections.title: Wildfire Insurance Claims Agents
sections.description: For Mercury Insurance (LA HQ) and LA's property insurance community.

blocks.heading: Wildfire claims coordination agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents coordinating wildfire insurance claims for Mercury's and other insurers' LA policyholders — gathering documentation, requesting additional information, coordinating with adjusters, and tracking claims through the process for the enormous claim volumes that LA wildfire events create.

blocks.heading: California FAIR Plan coordination
paragraphs: Agents managing the claims process for policyholders who have been placed in the California FAIR Plan (the insurer of last resort) — coordinating between the FAIR Plan, excess and surplus lines insurers, and policyholders.

blocks.heading: Property damage documentation agents
paragraphs: Agents organizing aerial imagery, third-party damage assessments, and policyholder documentation for LA wildfire claims processing.

sections.title: Healthcare Prior Authorization Agents
sections.description: For Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, UCLA Health, and Kaiser Permanente SoCal.

blocks.heading: California payer PA agents
paragraphs: Autonomous prior authorization agents for California's complex payer mix (Anthem Blue Cross CA, Blue Shield CA, Kaiser's self-authorization, Health Net, and Medi-Cal) — the California payer environment's specific PA requirements differ significantly from other state markets and require California-specific design.

blocks.heading: Cancer treatment PA agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents for oncology PA — a particularly challenging automation target because cancer treatment authorization often requires sequential approval processes across multiple treatment components.

blocks.heading: California CMIA-compliant health agents
paragraphs: Healthcare agents processing California patient information must comply with both HIPAA and the California Medical Information Act — ClickMasters designs all LA healthcare agents with CMIA compliance.

sections.title: Entertainment and Immigration Legal Agents
sections.description: For Gibson Dunn, O'Melveny & Myers, and LA's large legal community.

blocks.heading: Entertainment contract monitoring agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents tracking expiration dates, exercise deadlines, and payment milestones across LA law firms' large entertainment client contract portfolios.

blocks.heading: Immigration status monitoring agents
paragraphs: Agents monitoring visa status, work authorization expiration, and filing deadlines for the immigration law firms serving LA's large immigrant professional community.

blocks.heading: Regulatory compliance monitoring
paragraphs: Agents tracking California employment law developments — FEHA regulations, PAGA amendments, and wage and hour guidance updates for LA's employment law practices.

sections.title: Real Estate Intelligence Agents
sections.description: For CBRE LA, JLL Los Angeles, and institutional real estate investors.

blocks.heading: Wildfire exposure monitoring agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents monitoring Cal FIRE updates, fire weather warnings, and red flag conditions for LA real estate portfolios in fire-prone areas — generating portfolio risk alerts and evacuation access reports.

blocks.heading: Permit and entitlement monitoring
paragraphs: Agents tracking LA city planning commission filings, conditional use permit applications, and zoning change proposals for real estate investors monitoring development pipeline and competitive supply.

sections.title: Los Angeles AI agent standards
sections.description: Key compliance standards for Los Angeles AI agent deployments.

blocks.heading: CCPA for all consumer-facing agents
paragraphs: Agents processing California consumer data must comply with CCPA's data minimization, purpose limitation, and consumer rights requirements. ClickMasters designs all LA consumer-facing agents with CCPA compliance.

blocks.heading: SAG-AFTRA AI awareness
paragraphs: Entertainment agents that process or interact with content involving performer likenesses or voice must be designed within current SAG-AFTRA AI provisions — ClickMasters designs entertainment monitoring agents for rights violation detection, not performer simulation.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted for studio IP
paragraphs: Entertainment IP monitoring agents process proprietary studio content that cannot be transmitted to external APIs — ClickMasters deploys all entertainment agent AI on studio corporate infrastructure.
